brief.direction: A harbour office that posts the tide times by hand

naturalSourceText:
At the heart of the bustling seaside town lies the harbour office, a quaint building that plays a vital role in the local community. Each day, the dedicated staff take the time to post the tide times by hand, a tradition that has been upheld for generations. With a large chalkboard outside, they carefully write the times in clear, bold letters, ensuring that fishermen, sailors, and curious visitors alike can easily read them. 

This manual process may seem old-fashioned in an age dominated by technology, but it fosters a sense of connection to the sea and its rhythms. Locals often stop by to chat with the staff, sharing stories about their adventures on the water. The harbour office not only provides essential information but also serves as a gathering place, where the community comes together to celebrate the tides that shape their lives. As the sun rises and sets, the tide times remain a constant reminder of the ever-changing nature of the sea, cherished by all who call this town home.
